name: viberaven
description: VibeRaven Studio and architecture/production-context skills for AI-built apps.

interface.shortDescription: Give agents architecture, release, and provider context before fixes.
interface.longDescription: Open the VibeRaven Studio with npx -y viberaven, or install the skills pack so coding agents follow one senior-engineer flow: architecture, version/release context, provider boundary, MCP/Studio context, then the smallest safe fix.
defaultPrompt: Use architecture-context at the start of real app work to ask low-level product questions, then route answered work to architecture-plan before a fix.
Use the VibeRaven flow: architecture questions -> architecture plan -> version/release context -> provider boundary -> MCP/Studio context -> scoped fix.
Ask concise missing-context questions before planning when architecture, last working version, provider, or deploy target is unclear.
Use what-broke to find what changed and which architecture boundary is affected before editing.
Use go-live when the user wants GitHub push, Vercel deploy, and live URL proof.
